visualCharacteristics: Interactive swipe slider of linked promo images.
contentPattern: Image-only linked promo slides, several visible at once, free-scroll with scrollbar (not one full-width slide).
usage: Row of linked promotional visuals shown several at a time with a scrollbar and prev/next arrows (e.g. homepage service promos next to the welcome panel). One row per slide: cell 1 image, cell 2 link (link text is used as the accessible label).
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only linked promos. For a single full-width hero slider with text use carousel; for logos use cards-logos.
